checkout_no_lines: Add at least one product before charging.
checkout_bad_sale_number: The invoice number is not valid.
checkout_product_gone: A product in the sale no longer exists.
checkout_cash_short: The amount received does not cover the sale total.
checkout_unreadable_lines: The sale detail could not be read.
checkout_invoice_needs_client: An electronic invoice needs a customer. Choose one or issue a receipt.
checkout_document_type_not_enabled: This business does not issue that document. Choose another.
checkout_bad_document_type: That document is not issued at checkout.
checkout_invoice_needs_resident: A foreign customer cannot receive an electronic invoice: issue an export invoice or a ticket instead.
checkout_export_needs_client: The export invoice needs a foreign customer.
checkout_export_needs_foreign_client: The export invoice is for foreign customers. Issue this customer an invoice or a ticket.
checkout_export_needs_foreign_address: The customer has no foreign address. Complete it in their record before exporting.
checkout_export_line_needs_tariff_headin: {product} has no tariff heading. Complete it in the product record before exporting.
checkout_export_tariff_not_allowed: {product} uses tax rate code {tax_code}, which the export invoice does not allow. Change it in the product record or issue a ticket.
